`-- MappingPocPage(services) -> MappingWorkspacePage
    |-- workspace: CanvasWorkspace                       owns session lifetimes
    |   |-- store.drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
    |   |   |-- name / representationId? / revisionId / hidden? / busy
    |   |   |-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges?      saved baseline
    |   |   |-- viewport? / focusBox?                    view metadata
    |   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
    |   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController  domain state owner
    |   |       |   |-- getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot
    |   |       |   |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
    |   |       |   |   |-- canUndo / canRedo / cell? / endpointBounds?
    |   |       |   |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
    |   |       |   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox          recursive placement
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- id / position { column, row }
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- minimumSize? / collapsed
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- collapsedContentId?
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- kind: diagram -> contentId
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |   `-- kind: container
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |       |-- children[]: GridBox
    |   |       |   |   |   |   |       `-- layout { collisionPolicy: push-right, gap }
    |   |       |   |   |   |   `-- contents[contentId]: Diagram
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |-- diagramId / revisionId   service identities
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |-- id / revision            local content key/version
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |-- content: DiagramContent
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |   |-- revisionId / ascii / asciiSha256
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |   `-- structure
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |       |-- kind: diagram
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |       `-- kind: tree
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |           |-- parserVersion / rootIds[]
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |           `-- nodes[id]: DiagramContentNode
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |               |-- label / line / column spans
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |               `-- parentId? / childIds[] / foldRanges[]
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |-- sourceContext
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |   |-- binding? { sourceId, repositoryIdentity,
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |   |             corpus, domainProfileId }
    |   |       |   |   |   |       |   `-- contentHash / mappings[] / evidence[id]
    |   |       |   |   |   |       `-- jumps?: DiagramJump[]
    |   |       |   |   |   `-- edges[]: DiagramConnection / jumps? / sections
    |   |       |   |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
    |   |       |   |       |-- selection.items[]: SelectionItem  ordered membership
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- id / displayNodeId
    |   |       |   |       |   `-- region?                       absent = whole diagram
    |   |       |   |       |       `-- sourceContentId / sourceRevisionId? / sourceAscii
    |   |       |   |       |           rect / selectedIds[]      captured selection
    |   |       |   |       |-- diagramViews?                     content fold state
    |   |       |   |       |-- display: DisplayState             floating ownership tree
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- rootIds[] / nodes[id]: FloatingPane
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- shared: childIds[] / expansion / geometryPolicy
    |   |       |   |       |   |           position / bounds / coordinateSpace
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- selection: captured region / displayMode / activeChildId?
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- projection: title / revision links / content
    |   |       |   |       |   |   `-- call-tree | compaction | source-code | code-panel
    |   |       |   |       |   |-- conversation: thread / draft / canvasAnchor
    |   |       |   |       |   |   `-- presentation: compact | floating | docked
    |   |       |   |       |   `-- detail: title / ascii / sectionId?
    |   |       |   |       `-- controls: activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
    |   |       |   |           `-- surfaces[id]: SelectionSurfaceState
    |   |       |   |               `-- actions / projection choice / prompt / ask / status
    |   |       |   |-- nodes(): CanvasDisplayNode[]      derived read-only registry
    |   |       |   |   |-- shared: id / version / childIds / expansion / collapsible
    |   |       |   |   |-- grid:<boxId>                  diagram | group; cell bounds
    |   |       |   |   |-- floating:<id>                 pane; pixel geometry
    |   |       |   |   `-- arrow                         derived from document.edges
    |   |       |   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
    |   |       |   |   `-- validate -> stage edits -> reconcile -> commit -> publish
    |   |       |   |-- DiagramService                    sole diagram content writer
    |   |       |   |   `-- create / revise / generate -> DiagramRevisionResult
    |   |       |   |       `-- diagram / revision / nodeIds correspondence
    |   |       |   `-- CanvasHistoryService              history and storage boundary
    |   |       |       |-- context: CanvasEditingContext  runtime handle only
    |   |       |       |-- append / navigate / reset / resolve
    |   |       |       `-- exportContext / forkContext / persistenceChanges
    |   |       `-- readable stores                       immutable controller references
    |   |           |-- document / presentation / selection / controls / geometry
    |   |           `-- status { isDirty, sceneDirty, canUndo, canRedo }
    |   |-- controllers[documentId]                       references into sessions
    |   |-- changes.version / dirtyScenes.ids[]           workspace indexes
    |   `-- setDrafts()                                   create, subscribe, replace, dispose
    |-- activeId / mountedDocuments / transfers[]         page coordination
    |-- DraggableDiagramCanvas -> MappingPocSelectionCanvas(session)
    |   `-- previously visited documents stay mounted; active document is shown
    |-- SourcePaneViewState                              live camera and source scroll
    |   `-- captureCamera / captureDisplay               sample for persistence
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge -> handleAgentCommand
    |   |-- context -> { version, name, nodes, edges }    derived canvas model
    |   |-- snapshot -> controller snapshot + history + document metadata
    |   `-- apply -> controller.applyUpdate              shared mutation path
    |-- WorkspacePersistence                             subscribes to commits and view
    |   |-- per-session cursors -> history deltas
    |   |-- per-document metadata / baseline / canvas / viewport records
    |   `-- workspace index -> documentIds / activeDocumentId / transfers
    |-- WorkspaceStorage -> RecordStorage -> persistent worker -> records API
    |   `-- batch / flush / commit                        record transport and acknowledgement
    `-- workspace import/export: MappingWorkspaceSnapshot
        |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId? / transfers?
        `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
            |-- representationId / savedRepresentationId? / name / revisionId
            |-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges? / hidden?
            `-- document / canvas / history? / viewport?
